demo.title: Demo with sample data
demo.body: This app calls the real MarktMentor API with the public test key mm_test_demo. The test key answers from production data recorded on 17 November 2026 for a closed set: the niche “drinkfles” and its 10 best-selling products, plus the fictional store “Voorbeeldwinkel BV”. Search, filters, sorting, pages, markets and periods work on that set. Each product and niche in a list opens; a code that you type outside the set gives HTTP 404. This is not live data.
demo.ownData: For your own data, run this app on your computer with your own API key in MARKTMENTOR_API_KEY.
demo.notFoundHint: The test key knows only its example products and the niche “drinkfles”. Open one of the examples, or pick a product from the Products or Niches page.
demo.oneNiche: The test key has one example niche, so sorting and the page size do not change this list.

footer: Example project for the MarktMentor Public API. With your own key it runs on your own computer only (127.0.0.1); only demo mode with the public test key may be public. The general terms of MarktMentor apply to the data, also in the local database.

quota.label: Research requests
quota.tooltip: From the X-Research-Requests-Remaining header of the last response.

source.cacheTip: From the local SQLite cache, fetched {time}. This cost no request.
source.liveTip: Fetched just now. This used one research request.
source.liveFreeTip: Fetched just now. Store requests are free.

common.nextCost: The next page uses one research request.

overview.todayCached: {n} answers came from the cache, at no cost.
overview.noResearchTitle: This key has no research access
overview.noResearchBody: The API needs an active paid MarktMentor Premium subscription or higher (a trial does not count). Then the organization gets 100 free research requests per month, or more with an API bundle. My store needs no bundle: store requests are free.
overview.refreshCost: Uses at most {n} research requests: one per product, once a day.
overview.refreshDone: {fetched} fetched ({fetched} requests), {cached} from the cache (no requests).
overview.localDescription: The database is data/marktmentor.db. Use the data for your own business only. Clear it when you no longer need it or when your API access ends.
overview.clearBody: This deletes the cache, the products you follow and their history from data/marktmentor.db. You cannot undo this.

products.title: Products
products.description: Search bol product data for the Netherlands and Belgium. Each page of 25 products is one research request. The same search on the same day comes from the cache.
products.emptyHint: This still counted as one request. Check the spelling: all words must match.
products.unfollowed: You no longer follow this product.

product.historyDescription: Estimated sales for the whole market, not your own orders. One research request per period.
product.snapshotsDescription: One row per day and market, from your local database. Refresh them every day on the overview page.
product.noSnapshots: Follow this product to keep a daily snapshot.

niches.title: Niches
niches.description: A niche is a search term with its demand and supply. Each page of results is one research request.
niches.emptyHint: This still counted as one request.
niches.productsDescription: This page uses two research requests: the niche and its first 25 products.

store.title: My store
store.description: The figures of your own connected bol store. Store requests are free and need no bundle.
store.productsDescription: Only products with orders in the period, highest revenue first. Not your full catalogue.
store.costsHidden: Product and shipping costs are hidden for this store.
store.stockDescription: Stock of the active fulfilment method per product. Unknown is not zero: the stock was not available or too old.
store.emptyProducts: No products with orders in this period.

codes.not_authenticated: No key was sent. Add MARKTMENTOR_API_KEY to .env.
codes.authentication_failed: The key is wrong or revoked, or its creator is no longer an administrator. Create a new key in Settings → MarktMentor API.
codes.api_terms_required: The owner or an administrator of the organization must accept the general terms in the dashboard: Settings → MarktMentor API.
codes.product_research_api_required: Research needs an API bundle or research access from MarktMentor. My store works without a bundle.
codes.subscription_required: The API needs an active paid MarktMentor Premium subscription or higher. A trial does not count.
codes.insufficient_scope: The credential does not have the necessary scope.
codes.store_not_connected: Connect your bol store in the dashboard first.
codes.bundle_exhausted: The bundle is used up for this billing period. The app waits for the next period.
codes.overage_limit_reached: The maximum for extra requests is reached. The owner can raise it in the dashboard.
codes.free_quota_exhausted: The 100 free research requests for this month are used up. Choose an API bundle, or wait for the next calendar month.
codes.invalid_query: A parameter is not valid. See the details below.
codes.reserve_reached: The app stops at the reserve to protect your allowance. Change MARKTMENTOR_RESERVE in .env.
codes.not_found: This product or niche does not exist.
codes.not_found_html: The path does not exist, the key is not valid, or the API is not enabled for your organization yet (early access). Check MARKTMENTOR_API_BASE_URL or contact MarktMentor.
codes.follow_limit: The demo follows at most 50 products per visitor. Stop following a product first.
codes.network_error: The API cannot be reached. Check your connection and MARKTMENTOR_API_BASE_URL.
codes.research_unavailable: Research data is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
codes.billing_period_changed: A new billing period started. Try again.
codes.bundle_payment_failed: The payment for your API bundle failed. The owner of the organization needs to update the payment method; the bundle continues when the payment succeeds. My store keeps working.
codes.store_unavailable: The store data is temporarily unavailable at MarktMentor. Try again later; research keeps working.

errors.reserveDetail: {left} research requests left; the reserve is {reserve}.

rate.title: Per-minute limits
rate.tooltip: From the RateLimit-* headers of the last response. Each group has its own limit per minute for your organization. On HTTP 429 the app waits for Retry-After.

requests.title: Recent requests
requests.description: The last 15 calls of this app, from the local log. Use it to see the limits at work: status, the per-minute limit left after each call, and Retry-After on HTTP 429.
requests.emptyHint: Search for a product to see the first request here.

tabs.cost: Each tab is one research request when you open it (two for reviews). The same request on the same day comes from the cache.

visibility.title: Visibility history
visibility.description: How often the product was shown: on category pages and in search results for keywords. Both markets added up.
visibility.empty: No visibility data in this period.

rankings.title: Category rankings
rankings.description: The average position of the product in each of its categories. Lower is better.

keywordRankings.title: Keyword rankings
keywordRankings.description: The average position of the product in the bol search results, for the 10 keywords with the most search volume. Lower is better.
keywordRankings.empty: No keyword positions in this period.

rankTable.upTip: Places gained since the start of the period
rankTable.downTip: Places lost since the start of the period
rankTable.legend: Position 1 at the top. Select a row for its chart.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: The search terms where the product shows up, with its position and the search volume per market.

sellers.title: Sellers and buy box
sellers.description: Who sells the product, their share of the buy box and their average price in the period.
sellers.hoursInBuyBox: Average hours in the buy box
sellers.hasMore: The list is incomplete: not every seller is in this answer (hasMore).

reviews.listDescription: Newest first by default. Filter by period, score, verified purchases or a word.
reviews.noneBody: The review endpoints have no reviews for this item yet.
reviews.noneFromBol: This product has {n} reviews on bol. The review count comes from bol, and not every review is available through the API.
reviews.scopeFamilyNote: Reviews of the whole product family, as bol shows them and as reviewCount counts them.
reviews.scopeOwnNote: Only the reviews written for this EAN (includeVariants=false).

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: The other products in the same family (variantsOf).

periodsTable.title: Compare periods
periodsTable.description: The same niche over 30 days, 90 days and 1 year (comparePeriods). This is part of the niche request, so it costs nothing extra.

distributions.title: Product distribution
distributions.description: How many products of the niche fall in each price, sales and revenue range. Both markets together.

reviewHistory.title: Review history
reviewHistory.description: New reviews per period and their average rating, for all products in the niche.

filters.allMarketsOnly: Revenue and price filters and sorting work for NL + BE only.
filters.cost: A search costs one research request per page. The same search on the same day comes from the cache.
filters.limitNote: A search shows at most the first 10,000 results. Use filters to reach the rest.
filters.categoryTip: Category ID {id}. Select to search products in this category.
filters.categoryHelp: Pick a category from the bol category tree: search by name, or browse with ›.
filters.storeCategoryHelp: The same category number as in Product Research, at any level of the path.

niche.vsYear: vs. an average {days} days in the last year
niche.scoreHint: Quality and competition scores from 0 to 10.
niche.marketPeriod: These figures follow the market and period above.

home.title: Overview
home.description: The products you follow, with their trend, and your store at a glance.
home.revenueHint: Last 30 days, NL + BE, from the last snapshot
home.changeHint: Sales in the last full month against the month before
home.noTrend: Load the trends to see this
home.chartDescription: Monthly sales, NL + BE, full months only, from the sales history in the cache.
home.chartEmpty: Load the trends to see the chart.
home.loadTrendsCost: Uses {n} research requests: one sales history per product. After that, the trends come from the cache.
home.trendsLoaded: {fetched} trends loaded ({fetched} requests), {cached} from the cache.
home.listDescription: Price, sales over 30 days and the trend per month.

home.storeDescription: The last 30 days of your connected bol store. Store requests are free.
home.followCost: Following also loads the trend line: one research request.
home.noRiser: No followed product went up last month.
home.noFaller: No followed product went down last month.

usagePage.title: API usage
usagePage.description: Your connection, the allowance, the limits per minute, the log of calls and the local data.

usagePage.cacheHint: Research answers stay valid for the rest of the day. A repeated question costs nothing.
usagePage.unmeteredNote: This research access is not counted: responses have no X-Research-Requests headers, so there is no allowance to show.
usagePage.freeNote: Free requests: 100 successful research requests per calendar month (UTC) for the organization, shared by all API keys and the portal. At most 25 results per page.

storeFilters.rangeHint: Pick a first and a last day (at most 366 days). The overview cards always use the number of days.
storeFilters.free: Store requests are free and need no bundle.
storeFilters.counts: {ok} in stock · {low} low · {out} out of stock · {unknown} unknown

defaults.productsHint: NL + BE, last 30 days, highest sales first. Search or filter to narrow the list.
defaults.niches: Niches with the highest search volume
defaults.nichesHint: NL + BE, last 30 days. Search or filter to narrow the list.
defaults.noAccessBody: This key has no research access (that needs a paid Premium subscription), so the app does not fetch a list. The store pages work without it.
defaults.reserveBody: Few research requests are left, so the app does not fetch a list on its own. Search yourself, or change MARKTMENTOR_RESERVE.

ticker.title: Last action

ticker.countsTip: Research requests from your allowance: since you opened this tab, and today (UTC). Cache and free calls are not counted.
ticker.localOnly: This meter reads the local log only. It never calls the API and costs nothing.
